'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Vikram Bali DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' DVD ROTS
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
